(Hyosub Shin/AJC) By Fletcher Page Oct 23, 2026 Six games into a 2-4 season, Brent Key is trying to figure out why a different Georgia Tech football team keeps showing up.
 There have been glimpses and flashes, as Key puts it. Enough good to upset previously undefeated Duke and rally from a 21-point deficit at Virginia Tech . Enough bad to lose three of the season’s first four games and fall into that hole against the Hokies in the first place.
 Key says six games should tell you who a team is. Six games have told him that he has a team whose identity is inconsistency.
 “It’s a little bit like a different team showing up every week,” he said.
